title: Knots and dynamics
container-title: Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians (Madrid, 2006), Vol. I
note: Proc. ICM (Madrid, 2006), Vol. I, EMS Press, Zürich (2007), 247-277. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.4171/022-1/11) and author open-access text (2026-11-28). Proves modular geodesics in UT(PSL_2(Z)\H) are isotopic to Lorenz template knots with linking number given by the Rademacher Dedekind-sum cocycle (Section 3.1-3.5).
